_comment: Functional QA benchmark manifest. Truth = each case's expected_outcome, written by a person BEFORE the run (PASS, FAIL = a known/planted defect or a negative control, SKIP = must not count as a pass). QAX never grades itself. 'start' says how the app was run, so a run can be repeated; an app that is not reachable is NOT RUN, never counted.
